Debit Note

The Debit Note view displays detailed information about a debit note issued to a supplier.

A debit note is a document sent to a supplier to inform them that their account has been debited, typically for returned goods, price adjustments, or billing errors.

From this view, you can edit the debit note details, print a copy for your records, or email it directly to the supplier.

For more information, see: Debit Note — Edit
